Waste collection

Household waste is collected weekly. Recycling is collected on alternate weeks.

Annual bin charge
€38.00 per household
Collection day
Tuesday, districts 1–4; Thursday, districts 5–8

Bulky items are collected twice a year by appointment. Garden waste sacks are available at the municipal depot.
